Hi Irene — thanks for the packet. A few items from AP to get you fully registered: 

1) Legal name and TIN/EIN exactly as you want it on our vendor file (this drives 1099/W9 mapping).
2) W-9 (we received your pdf, looks OK but please confirm entity type).
3) Remit-to address and EFT bank details (we require bank name, account number, routing, and ACH beneficiary name).
4) Invoices must include: PO number (required), invoice date, invoice number, invoice total, line-level description and quantity, tax/VAT amount if applicable, and our internal cost center code when provided on the PO.
5) PO format: we use TH-YYYY-##### and POs will always include the issuing BU code in the first segment. Please make sure your system can parse dashes.
6) Portal: I'll send a vendor portal invite (ProcureOps will create your vendor record). Once you accept, upload the W-9 and bank remit letter.

A couple of notes: we do not accept invoices by generic email unless there is a portal exception. For early invoices before portal activation, please email accounts-payable@therahealth.com with the cover note and reference to the portal invite ID.

I've created a ticket in our system and sent a portal invite link below — click "Register vendor" and use Redwood Inference legal name. If you prefer, our team can complete the portal form with details you provide via secure link.

Portal invite: https://therahealth.vendorportal.com/invite/ABC123-Redwood
Ticket: PROC-58791

Best,
Jason Cole
